- File: scripts/render_prompt.py
  Line or code reference: lines 612-620 (try/except wrapping resolve_identity_source_prompt and load_prompt)
  Problem: The single try/except block catches both resolve_identity_source_prompt raising (the prompt file does not exist on any search path) and load_prompt raising (the file exists but cannot be read — permission error, encoding error, etc.) under the same reason token "canonical_prompt_missing".

  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/render_prompt.py
  Line or code reference: lines ~633 and ~638 (phase_name is None guard and identity_metadata extraction guard inside apply_identity_recall_block)
  Problem: Three previously distinct failure reason tokens collapse to "metadata_extract_failed": the old "phase_name_missing" (canonical prompt found but its basename could not be resolved as a phase name) and "identity_metadata_incomplete" (role or mission parsed empty from the opening paragraph) both now emit "metadata_extract_failed", joining the existing metadata-extract-failure path.
  Why it fails at runtime: Loss of diagnostic granularity in IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL log lines. Operators and any log-based alerting keyed on the former tokens will miss these sub-classes.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
